service.description: What the name segments of a page's path are (design-smithy §4.4 step 4): a repository, a group, an account (a handle), or a redirect from a repository's old path or a GitHub form after a repository's path. Out: kind, groupId, repositoryId, handle, canonicalPath, redirectPath. Not Found for a path with no row and, exactly the same, for what the caller may not view.
The site's home group (SmithySite.homeGroupId) when the caller may view it: homeGroupId and groupPath, both empty when the home is Explore. Not Found on a site that is not open to the caller.

The groups the caller may view, by path, paged (the query takes what the caller's rows and the visibility allow, and the evaluator decides each): the top-level ones, the subgroups of parentGroupId, those matching query in path or name, or (mine) those the caller has a role row on. Each with the counts of the repositories and subgroups the caller may view. Not Found for a parent the caller may not view; sign-in required for mine.

A group, the groups above it (each with its name only when the caller may view that group itself, else its id and path), the caller's effective role and capabilities. Not Found for a group that is not there or that the caller may not view: narrower than the caller's access in effect, hidden, not yet active, or on a site that is not published.

The members of a group, each with the highest role of its rows on the group and the groups above and the path that row is on. An Owner sees every member, another viewer the members whose profile is shown to them. No party id is returned. Not Found as get#Group.

The repositories the caller may view, paged: of a group (with includeSubgroups those below it too), of a handle's namespace, matching query in path or name, pinned ones in their order, or (mine) those of the caller's namespace, rows and groups; sorted by path (sort pushed is by path too until a stored date of the last push is kept). Not Found for a group that is not there or not viewable, and for a handle whose profile is not shown to the caller and that has no repository the caller may view; sign-in required for mine.

A repository with its group (the group's view when the caller may view the group itself, else only its id and path), clone addresses (the page's own only where Smithy is the site's root app), the caller's effective role, capabilities and counts. Not Found for a repository that has no Smithy row in this site or that the caller may not view.

The directory at a refPath (a ref name followed by a path; empty: the default branch's root): up to 1,000 entries from offset, each with the framework's type (dir, file, executable, link, submodule), whether Git LFS keeps it and its last commit, the path's last commit and the directory's README rendered and cleaned. empty for a repository with no commit; isFile when the path is a file. Not Found as get#Repository, and for a ref or path that names nothing.

A file at a refPath: its size, blob id and last commit, its text up to 1 MiB (tooLarge beyond), Markdown rendered and cleaned unless plain, binary and lfs marked with no content. Not Found as get#Repository, and for a refPath that is no file.

A file's raw content: file (filename, mimeType, size, inline) with text or bytes. The type is text/plain, a raster image's, or application/octet-stream, never one a browser runs. Refused (notAvailable) for a file kept in Git LFS. Not Found as get#Blob.

Blame of a file at a refPath: its text and, in line order, each run of lines with the commit that last changed them (startLine, lineCount, commitId, summary, authorName, date). No address is returned and authorHandle is always empty. Not Found as get#Blob. Refused (Unprocessable): a file over 1 MiB, a binary file, a file kept in Git LFS, and a history the framework's limit does not read.

The history of a ref, or of a path at a ref, newest first: 30 commits a page (limit to 100), the next page after afterCommitId. A commit has the author's name and no address (authorHandle is always empty: an address is not matched to an account). Not Found as get#Repository and for a ref that names nothing.

A commit by its id (7 to 40 hex digits): the files it changed with their counts, their diffs within the page's limits (100 files, 20,000 changed lines; truncated says more were left out) or the one of path, in one diff call (a commit of more than 100 files has its file list and no diffs: truncated), and its statuses. Not Found as get#Repository and for an id that names no commit.

What head has that base (the default branch when empty) lacks, each side a branch, a tag or a commit id and nothing else: the commits, ahead and behind, the files, with withDiffs their diffs within the page's limits, with checkMergeable whether it merges cleanly (a trial merge; mergeable is empty without it), and the open merge request of the two branches. Refused (notBuilt) for a head in another repository. Not Found as get#Repository and for a side that names no branch, tag or commit.

The branches and tags of a repository, paged: the default branch first, branches by name, tags newest first, each with its name, commit, summary and date. With refType branch and without namesOnly also each branch's ahead and behind the default branch, whether a rule protects it and its open merge request (the Branches page; a ref picker asks namesOnly). Not Found as get#Repository.

The tree at a branch, a tag or a commit as a zip or tar.gz, a file the transport streams: file (filename, mimeType, size), commitId, and the file's location, which stays with the authority. For a signed-in account (the framework has no cap by client for anonymous callers). Not Found as get#Repository and for a ref that names nothing or a repository with no commit. Refused (Unprocessable): a refPath with a path after the ref, a format other than zip or tar.gz, and a tree over the framework's limits.

The site's Smithy settings. For the site's owners and operators: who may make a group, a personal repository and a fork (operators, request, verified), the home group (homeGroupId, homeGroupPath), the default limits, the kind of a new repository and revision (0 until the settings are first stored). For anyone else only groupCreate, repositoryCreate and forkCreate. Everyone also gets capabilities: what the caller may start (canRequestGroup, canCreateRepository) and whether a group request of theirs is waiting. Not Found on a site that is not open to the caller.

Change the site's Smithy settings; a field that is not given stays. For the site's owners and operators (accessDenied for anyone else, a moderator too), with a confirmed address. Refused: a policy that is not operators, request or verified; a limit that is not a whole number (an empty one is the default again); a repositoryKind other than db or local; a homeGroupPath that names no active group of the site (empty: the home is Explore); an expectedRevision that is not current (staleRevision).

Ask for, or make, a top-level group, by the site's policy: active at once by the verified policy and for the site's owners and operators, who become its Owner; requested by the request policy, to be decided by the site's owners. Idempotent by operationId. Refused: no sign-in; no confirmed address (addressUnconfirmed); a suspended or silenced account (accessDenied); the operators policy for anyone else (policyRefused); a path that is not a group's (nameInvalid) or is in the site's name set, an old path that still redirects included (nameTaken); an account with a request waiting (Conflict); a name, description or reason the forum's rules block or hold (Unprocessable).

The group requests of a site by status (requested when empty), oldest first, paged: each with its group, the requester's handle, the reason and when it was made. For the site's owners and operators (accessDenied for anyone else).

Approve or refuse a group request. On approval the group is active and its requester gets the Owner role. For the site's owners and operators. Refused: a request that is decided already (Conflict); an expectedRevision that is not current (staleRevision); a refusal with no reason.

Make a subgroup of a group, by an Owner of it. Idempotent by operationId. Refused: a caller who may not view the group (Not Found) or is no Owner of it (accessDenied); no confirmed address (addressUnconfirmed); a path that is not a group's (nameInvalid) or that a subgroup or repository of the group has (nameTaken); a visibility wider than the group's effective one, a fifth level, or a group that is not active (policyRefused); text the forum's rules block or hold.

Change a group's name, description, avatar, visibility and issue repository, by an Owner; a field that is not given stays. A narrower visibility is given to every subgroup and repository below that was wider, and narrowedCount says how many. Refused: a visibility wider than the group above (policyRefused); an issueRepositoryPath that names no repository of the group; an avatar that is no scanned image of the caller's; text the forum's rules block or hold; staleRevision.

Change a group's path segment, by an Owner: the path of the group, of every subgroup below and of every repository below changes in one transaction, each repository through set#GitRepositoryPath (so git keeps serving its old path), and the group's old path redirects (SmithyPathRedirect) until it is taken: at once by the group itself or its Owners, by anyone else after 90 days. Refused: nameInvalid; nameTaken (the site's name set for a top-level group, the parent's subgroups and repositories for a subgroup, an old path that still redirects); staleRevision.

Delete an empty group, by an Owner, with its path typed to confirm: its role rows and the redirects to it go with it. Refused: a confirmPath that is not its path; a group that has a repository or a subgroup (Conflict); staleRevision.

Give an account (by its handle) a role on a group, change it, set its end date, or with an empty role remove it; by an Owner. Out: member. Refused: a handle that is no account's of the site; a role that is none of the five; a change that would leave the group, with the groups above it, without an Owner whose role has no end (Conflict); staleRevision for a row that is there.
Give up the caller's own role on a group (left is false when it has none on the group itself). Refused: the last Owner (Conflict).

The members of a repository, paged: each role row on the repository itself, each account's highest role from its groups (fromPath says where the row is) and, for a personal repository, its namespace's account as Owner. For a Maintainer (accessDenied below that; Not Found for who may not view it). No party id is returned.

Give an account (by its handle) a role on a repository, change it, set its end date, or with an empty role remove it; by an Owner. Out: member. Refused: a handle that is no account's of the site; a role that is none of the five; staleRevision for a row that is there.

Change a repository's name, description, default branch, default merge method (merge or squash), what it has turned on, its docs directory and, by an Owner of its group, its pin; by a Maintainer. A field that is not given stays. Refused: an archived repository (repositoryArchived); a default branch that is no branch; text the forum's rules block or hold; staleRevision.
Set a repository's visibility, by an Owner. Out: visibility, effectiveVisibility, revision. Refused: a visibility wider than its group's effective one (policyRefused); staleRevision.

Change a repository's slug, by an Owner: its path changes through set#GitRepositoryPath, which keeps the old path as a redirect for git and the pages. Refused: nameInvalid; nameTaken (a subgroup or repository of its group, another repository's path, or an old path that still redirects: free at once for its own repository or Owners, after 90 days for anyone else); staleRevision.

Move a repository to another group, or with no targetGroupId to the caller's own namespace, by an Owner of it who is a Maintainer of the target group. Its visibility is narrowed to the target group's when it was wider; its path changes and the old one redirects. Refused: a target group the caller may not view (Not Found) or is no Maintainer of (accessDenied); a name taken there (nameTaken); the account's count of personal repositories, or a repository larger than one may be there (quotaExceeded); the site's policy for personal repositories (policyRefused); issues in the old group's shared project (Conflict); staleRevision.

Archive a repository (read only from now: pushes and writes are refused, its open merge requests closed) or make it writable again, by an Owner. Out: archived, closedMergeRequestCount, revision. Refused: staleRevision.

Delete a repository, by an Owner, with its path typed to confirm: Smithy's rows, Mantle's links of its commits, refs and merge requests to tasks (the tasks stay in their project), and the hosted repository (delete#GitRepository). It cannot be undone. Refused: a confirmPath that is not its path; staleRevision; notBuilt where the framework has no delete.
A repository's branch rules, for a Maintainer: each with its pattern, what it allows and requires, the required status contexts and the allowed merge methods (merge, squash, fastForward, rebase).

Make (no branchRuleId: idempotent by operationId) or change a branch rule, by a Maintainer; requiredStatusContexts and allowedMergeMethods are comma separated. Refused: an archived repository (repositoryArchived); a branchRuleId that is no rule of this repository (Not Found); a merge method that is none.
Delete a branch rule of a repository, by a Maintainer. Not Found for a rule that is not this repository's.
A repository's webhooks, for a Maintainer; a secret is never returned (hasSecret).

Make (no webhookId: idempotent by operationId) or change a webhook, by a Maintainer: an http or https URL, the events (push, tag, merge_request, comma separated; all when empty), a secret (kept when empty on an edit), active. Refused: a URL or an event the framework refuses (Unprocessable); a webhookId that is no webhook of this repository (Not Found).
Delete a webhook of a repository, by a Maintainer. Not Found for one that is not this repository's.
Send a ping to a webhook now, by a Maintainer. Out: statusCode, delivered, errorText. Not Found for one that is not this repository's.
The deliveries of a webhook, newest first, paged, for a Maintainer: each with its event, date, status code and whether it was delivered.

Make a branch or a tag (annotated when a message is given) from a branch, a tag or a commit id (the default branch's head when empty), by a Developer. Idempotent by operationId. Refused: a name that exists (Conflict); a branch rule (accessDenied); an archived repository (repositoryArchived); a name that is no ref name.

Delete a branch or a tag, by a Maintainer. Refused: the default branch (Conflict); a branch rule that does not allow the delete (accessDenied); an archived repository (repositoryArchived). Not Found for a ref that is not there.
The caller's own SSH keys and access tokens (never a key's or a token's secret), where git over SSH is reached, and whether the account has a confirmed address, which a push needs.

Add an SSH public key to the caller's account, after the password (and the second factor's code) again. Idempotent by operationId. Refused: no confirmed address (addressUnconfirmed); a wrong password (sign-in required); text that is no public key (Unprocessable); a key in use (Conflict).
End one of the caller's own SSH keys. Not Found for a key that is not the caller's.

Make an access token for git over HTTPS for the caller's account, after the password again; it expires at expiresAt (within a year; 90 days when empty). The token is in the result once and is never kept, so a repeated operationId answers without it. Refused: no confirmed address (addressUnconfirmed); a wrong password.
End one of the caller's own access tokens. Not Found for a token that is not the caller's.

The limits and the usage of a group (for its Owner and the site's owners), of an account by its handle (the account itself and the site's owners) or, with neither, of the caller: the count of repositories, the largest repository's bytes, the LFS bytes and the runner minutes, with the repositories and, for an account, the bot mark. Bytes are the framework's count and empty when it cannot say.

Set the limits of a group or of an account (by its handle), and for an account the bot mark and its operator, by the site's owners and operators; an empty limit is the site's default again. Refused: maxRepositories or the bot mark with a groupId; a handle that is no account's; staleRevision (0 for an account with no limits yet).

The PASS Account hub's card of Smithy (design-smithy §11 GitAccess): the signed-in account's counts of SSH keys, access tokens and personal repositories, with the Git access page and its namespace's page. No card (an empty result) for no sign-in and on a site that does not mount Smithy.

What a user, or no user (an empty userId, or one with no UserAccount), holds on a hosted repository by Smithy's rules (design-smithy §5.1, §5.2, §5.4): known is false for a repository with no SmithyRepository row, and then nothing else is said. canView is the effective visibility (the narrowest of the repository's and its groups': anyone for public, the site's active members for members, a role for private), the hidden and group status rules, the site's publication and the role; role is the effective role's SmithyRole id, the highest of the party's active rows on the repository and its groups, its personal namespace and its project roles, and empty when the repository may not be viewed or the party is suspended in the site; confirmed is whether the account has a confirmed address (an internal account: an address). An operator's page role is not counted here: git has the ADMIN grant for it.

parameter.name: rank
parameter.description: The role's rank (10 Guest to 50 Owner), 0 for none

actions.script: const held = ec.resource.script("component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/smithy/Smithy.js").rights(repositoryId, userId) known = held.known canView = held.canView role = held.role rank = held.rank confirmed = held.confirmed

service.description: Make an active group, for operators, seed data and specs (the operations are requestGroup and createSubgroup, which add the site's creation policy): a top-level one by the site's owner or an operator (not a moderator), who becomes its Owner, or a subgroup by an Owner of parentGroupId. Refused: no confirmed address (addressUnconfirmed; an operator needs none); a path segment that is not 2 to 39 lower case letters, digits, '_' or '-' (nameInvalid); a top-level name in the site's name set, which is its groups, its handles, the reserved paths, the apps' mounts and Smithy's own words, or a subgroup name its parent's subgroups or repositories have (nameTaken; a refused group's path is free, and its row is taken over); a subgroup wider than its parent or below the fourth level (policyRefused); a caller without the role (accessDenied).

parameter.name: visibility
parameter.description: public, members or private; the parent's effective one, else private, when empty

actions.script: const made = ec.resource.script("component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/smithy/Smithy.js").createGroup( {siteId, parentGroupId, pathSegment, name, description, visibility}) groupId = made.groupId groupPath = made.groupPath

service.description: Two callers. With input, the operation createRepository (design-smithy §15.3): a repository in a group by a Maintainer of it, or in the caller's own namespace by the site's policy for personal repositories (verified: any account with a confirmed address; else the site's owners) and within the account's count (quotaExceeded), of the site's kind (db, or local), with "Start with a README" its first commit; idempotent by operationId; its name and description pass the forum's rules. Without input, for operators, seed data and specs: a repository in a group by a Maintainer of it, or in the caller's own namespace (its handle), by the site's owner or an operator: a new hosted repository (local, or db). Either way its path is the group's path or the handle, then the slug, set through set#GitRepositoryPath. Refused: no confirmed address (addressUnconfirmed; an operator needs none); a slug that is not a repository name (nameInvalid); a name its group's subgroups or repositories have, or a path that is taken (nameTaken); a visibility wider than its group's effective one, or a group that is not active (policyRefused); a caller without the role (accessDenied).

parameter.name: input
parameter.description: The operation createRepository: PASS's input map, and then the other parameters are not read

parameter.name: name
parameter.description: As typed; the slug when empty

parameter.name: visibility
parameter.description: public, members or private; private when empty

parameter.name: repositoryKind
parameter.description: local (the default) or db, for a new one

parameter.name: branch
parameter.description: The default branch of a new one; main when empty

service.description: Bind a hosted repository that is there (a moqui.resource.GitRepository of any kind, a remote mirror included) to a group of a site, with a slug and a visibility: its SmithyRepository row, and its path (the group's path, then the slug) set through set#GitRepositoryPath. For an operator. Refused: a caller who is no operator (accessDenied); a repositoryId that names no hosted repository, or one Smithy has already; a slug that is not a repository name (nameInvalid); a name the group's subgroups or repositories have, or a path that is taken (nameTaken); a visibility wider than the group's effective one, or a group that is not active (policyRefused). A group of another site is Not Found.

parameter.name: name
parameter.description: As typed; the slug when empty

parameter.name: visibility
parameter.description: public, members or private; private when empty, never the group's

actions.script: repositoryPath = ec.resource.script("component://mr-mantle/service/mantle/smithy/Smithy.js").bindRepository( {siteId, repositoryId, groupId, slug, name, visibility}).repositoryPath

service.description: Turn the forum of a group (groupId) or of a repository (repositoryId) on or off, by its Owner: its category is published with its name and a visibility no wider than it, under the category of the group above (whose forum must be on); a repository gets its subcategory when its forum is first turned on, and its issues' and merge requests' conversations move to it. contactListId links an existing category of the site in place of its own, when the caller owns it and nothing else is bound to it. Out: contactListId, enabled, revision. Refused: a category of another site, one the caller does not own, or one bound elsewhere (Unprocessable); one wider than the group or repository, and a forum above that is off (policyRefused); staleRevision.

Report a repository or a group (targetType, targetId) the caller views, with a reason and a note, by an account with a confirmed address: one review item (target type repository or group, family flag) waits for a target in the queue of the scope above it (the group above; the site's staff for a top-level group and a personal repository), and each account's report is kept. Out: reported. Refused: the gate's limits (the day's, the time between two).

Hide a repository or a group (hidden true, with a reason), or show it again: hidden, it is Not Found to all but its Owners and the site's staff, on the pages and in git. By the site's staff (owners, moderators, operators) and by an Owner of a group above it, never by a role on the target itself. Logged in the forum's moderation log. Out: hidden, revision. Refused: accessDenied for another caller, and to show again what the site's staff hid; staleRevision.

The day's limit of pipeline runs an account asks for (by hand, or an outside run), by its trust level in the site (the post gate's kind pipelineRun, design-smithy §12.2): whether one more is allowed, and it is counted when it is. A Maintainer of the repository and the site's staff have no limit. For the CI's pre-queue hook (DG5); not an operation.
